players.name: Joey Slye
players.comment: Slye hit both field-goal tries and his two extra-point attempts in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

players.name: Chimere Dike
players.comment: Dike may have a significant role on offense with Carnell Tate (shoulder) ruled out for Sunday's game against Jacksonville.

players.name: JC Latham
players.comment: Latham (finger) practiced in full Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.comment: Pollard (finger/rest) was a full participant in Friday's practice and doesn't carry an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

players.name: Travon Walker
players.comment: Walker (ribs) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Titans, Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Foyesade Oluokun
players.comment: Oluokun recorded seven tackles (six solo), including 1.0 sacks, in Thursday's 33-10 victory over Baltimore.

players.name: Travis Hunter
players.comment: Hunter caught his only target for minus-1 yard and lost a fumble in Thursday night's 33-10 win over the Ravens.

players.name: Cam Little
players.comment: Little made all four of his field-goal attempts and all three of his extra-point tries in a 33-10 win over Baltimore on Thursday.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.comment: Myers (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's matchup with Tennessee, Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
players.comment: The Jaguars have relayed to inquiring teams that they intend to keep Thomas through Tuesday's trade deadline, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Robert Hainsey
players.comment: Hainsey has cleared the league's concussion protocol and will play against the Titans on Sunday.

players.name: Trevor Lawrence
players.comment: Lawrence completed 16 of 26 passes for 242 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions while rushing once for minus-1 yard in the Jaguars' 33-16 win over the Ravens on Thursday night.

players.name: Brenton Strange
players.comment: Strange caught both of his targets for 22 yards in Thursday night's 33-10 win over the Ravens.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.comment: Tuten (ankle/foot) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's matchup with Tennessee, Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com reports.
